dedupe_keys.name: dataset on dynamic grid emissions considering regional variations of the energy mix in electricity grids for 2024

description: Dataset on dynamic grid emissions considering regional variations of the energy mix in electricity grids for 2024 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Deepak Amaripadath, Aurora Luigia Teresa Bertini. This dataset provides the average dynamic grid emission factors considering regional variations of the energy mix in electricity grids from multiple cities worldwide for 2024. The datasets from [1] were used to estimate the average dynamic grid emission factors in gCO2eq. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
